en.html:
My arms and legs were heavy. As if somebody had filled them with lead.
What actually filled them, presumably, was the weight of having brought this on myself.

Here was the bill for that crude, furious assault.
Breathing, combustion, blood flow—all the 3B a warrior must not neglect had gone out of order.

My fighting ability was considerably reduced.

On the other side, the enemy continued with full-speed charges and full-force attacks, exactly as before.

Only the weapon had changed.
A chainsaw. Surely it was not meant to be used by smashing it into things. Perhaps combat modifications accounted for it, but even with that treatment it performed quite adequately.

The shoulder plate was the heaviest armor we had. Once it had been sliced like thin paper, I was in no position to laugh at that cheap-looking stage set.

ja.html:
手足が重い。鉛を詰められたようだ。
　実際に詰まっているのは、自業自得という四文字で
あろうが。

　逆上に任せて粗雑な猛攻を仕掛けた<ruby>債務<rt>ツケ</rt></ruby>だ。
　<ruby>呼吸<rt>ブレス</rt></ruby>、<ruby>燃焼<rt>バーン</rt></ruby>、<ruby>血流<rt>ブラッド</rt></ruby>――武者として軽視すべからざる
<ruby>身体機能<rt>３Ｂ</rt></ruby>が全て狂ってしまっていた。

　俺の戦闘能力は大幅に低下した状態にある。

　対して、敵は前と同様、<ruby>全速突進＋全力攻撃<rt>フルスピード・アンド・フルスイング</rt></ruby>。

　前と違うのはその武装だ。
　<ruby>回転鋸刀<rt>チェーンソー</rt></ruby>――それは本来叩き付けて使うような道具
ではない筈だが、戦闘用に改良を加えられているせい
なのか、そんな扱いでも充分に性能を発揮している。

　最も重厚な肩部甲鉄を薄紙も同然に切り裂かれては、
その見た目に安直な<ruby>舞台装置<rt>ステージセット</rt></ruby>を嘲笑ってやる事もでき
なかった。

...In short.
I was in the worst possible condition, and the enemy was more dangerous than before.

Not one more blow. I could not afford even one.
One would certainly deprive me of the ability to keep fighting.

This predicament was of my own making. For getting out of it, my own wits would have to suffice.
This exchange, and the one after it—most likely, my life would be decided there.

en.html:
—Let us make a plan.
Fight on instinct now, and I would lose my life.

With this breathless body, against that monster of strength, how was I to avoid defeat?
The decision required proper consideration.

Stake everything on an attack? Endure, and recover my position? Or something else?

...Whichever it was, once decided, there would probably be no margin for revision.
By the time I noticed the error, I would be dead.
So this instant, before committing myself, I had to think it through thoroughly.

First, I put the points requiring confirmation in order.
One by one, briefly, I asked Muramasa.

ja.html:
――戦術を組み立てよう。
　今、<ruby>勘<rt>カン</rt></ruby>任せの戦いをすれば命を落とす。

　息を切らしたこの身体が、剛力の怪物を相手にして、
如何にせば敗北を免れ得るか。
　慎重に考慮して決めねばならない。

　勝負に出るか、凌いで態勢を立て直すか、それとも。

　……いずれにせよ、一度決めたなら、もう修正する
余裕は無いであろう。

　誤りに気付いた時には死んでいるに違いない。
　だから――今この一瞬に、よくよく考え抜いて決め
なくては。

　俺はまず、確認すべき事柄を脳裏にまとめた。
　順々、手短に村正へと問う。
